The '''''Cutting Strike''''' was a [[YU-410 light freighter]] that was used by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The ''Strike'' was used by Black Sun as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship and was captained by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Malva Greeku]]. It operated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and on one occasion, lured the [[Action IV transport]] ''[[Azure Queen]]'' to the edge of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], where it ambushed the [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. The ''Strike'' jammed the ''Queen''{{'s}} [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transmitter]], then fired on it, leaving it stranded and bringing the transport's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] off-line. A Black Sun boarding crew was sent over from the ''Strike'' to the ''Queen'' and took control of the transport, then began repairing the hyperdrive. However, the Republic sent an [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|ILH-KK ''Citadel''-class cruiser]] to recapture the ''Azure Queen'', and it ambushed the ''Cutting Strike''.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
